candidates.why: Line 4461 calloc's HANDSEED as a fresh Dwg_Object_Ref but never sets handleref.is_global=1 and never registers it in dwg->object_ref (contrast decode.c:4640-4641). Later dwg_free_header_vars (free.c:1165 -> header_variables.spec:251 FIELD_DATAHANDLE -> VALUE_HANDLE at free.c:113-118) frees any ref with !is_global. If encode is re-run on the same dwg after such a free path that does not NULL the pointer, the guard at 4453 passes and 4475/4479 write through freed memory. Mitigated by free.c:117 setting ref=NULL, hence low confidence.
